methodSections.heading: Sponge Cake Layer
steps: Mix wet ingredients together in one bowl and sift the dry ingredients together into another bowl.
Mix the wet ingredients into the dry and spread on a parchment-lined baking dish or oven tray with sides.
Bake at 230°C (450°F) for 20-25 minutes. Allow to cool at room temperature.

methodSections.heading: Avocado Ganache
steps: Blend all ingredients in food processor until smooth.

methodSections.heading: Almond Mascarpone
steps: Soak the almonds overnight. Drain and then blend with 2½ L of fresh water until smooth.
Bring 250ml of water to a boil in a saucepan, whisk in the agar and allow to boil for a few minutes. Add this to the puréed almonds. Stir and then chill until set.
Once set, add to a food processor along with the vanilla scrapings, maple syrup, coconut cream and process until smooth.

methodSections.heading: Assembly
steps: Serve the tiramisu in glasses. Cut cake into glass-shaped rounds, and soak in a coffee liqueur like Tia Maria or Kahlúa, both are vegan according to their websites.
Alternate layers in the glass as follows, cake, ganache, mascarpone, repeat. Grate dark chocolate over the top and serve.
